params.body:
An app can now declare the command-line programs it shells out to
(Trendwolves/gentells-pipeline#178). This is the side that decides what an
absence is worth.

A command-line program is the one dependency npm and composer cannot carry, so
it arrives by hand and is written down nowhere. A rebuilt box discovers it when
the work fails. Gentells' public site did exactly that with poppler: the command
to publish a report stopped on `pdftoppm ontbreekt` on a machine with no sudo to
fix it, and the same programs had been assumed present on the Observatory for
months.

## What this reads

`extra.binaries` from the health contract, flattened to `binariesDeclared`,
`binariesMissing` and `binariesMissingNames`. The names travel because "one
program is missing" sends you looking and the name ends the search; each carries
what stops working without it, which is the part worth getting up for.

## What it judges

New facet `binaries`:

| threshold | field | level |
|---|---|---|
| `BINARIES_MISSING` | `binariesMissing >= 1` | now |
| `BINARIES_PRESENT` | `binariesMissing == 0` | ok |

**Required only.** An optional program that is absent by design (Docling on a
small box) would otherwise sit amber for ever, and a layer that is always amber
stops being read.

**An app that declares nothing is not judged on it.** Absent stays absent;
seventeen apps do not send this field and a zero would read as a measurement.

679 tests pass, 4 new. Pint and PHPStan clean.
params.title: Judge the programs an app says it needs
